title: Student Notebook Copilot attempts client-side updateDoc on users/{uid}.aiUsageCount, triggering PERMISSION_DENIED on every query
impact: firestore.rules:L31-L32 blocks client modifications to aiUsageCount, so every student Notebook Copilot request throws FirebaseError: Missing or insufficient permissions at L423, displays 'Copilot connection severed.' despite succeeding server-side, and reads stale aiUsageCount instead of server-incremented aiNotebookUsageCurrent.
recommendation: Delete the client-side updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid), { aiUsageCount: increment(1) }) call at L423-L425 and read userData.aiNotebookUsageCurrent at L115.

title: Missing allow update rule on /assignments/{id} breaks teacher assignment visibility toggles and edits
impact: firestore.rules only defines allow read, create, delete on /assignments/{id} (with allow update default-denied), causing updateDoc(doc(db, 'assignments', id), { visibility }) in src/app/teacher/assignments/page.tsx:L130 to fail with PERMISSION_DENIED whenever a teacher shares an assignment to Waypoints.
recommendation: Add allow update: if isSignedIn() && isOwner(resource.data.teacherId) && request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId; to match /assignments/{id} in firestore.rules.

title: Unbounded client writes and document-ID squatting on notebooks and tutor_sessions collections
impact: allow create on notebooks and tutor_sessions neither restricts document IDs nor enforces org notebookLimitPerStudent quotas or payload schemas, while allow read, delete: if id == request.auth.uid lets an attacker pre-create notebooks/<victimUid> with malicious content that is automatically migrated into the victim's notebooks on first visit (src/app/student/notebook/page.tsx:L182-L198).
recommendation: Remove id == request.auth.uid from notebooks/tutor_sessions rules, prevent creating docs with id == request.auth.uid, validate schema and size bounds on create/update, and enforce notebookLimitPerStudent via a server API route.

title: Failing emulator security test (npm run test:security exits 1) due to outdated Gemini 3.8 Flash cost assertion and .next/standalone haste collision
impact: tests/security/workflows.test.ts:L60 expects costCents == 0.28 (legacy $0.05/$0.20 rates), whereas functions/src/metering.ts:L11 calculates 0.45 cents ($0.05/$0.40 rates), causing CI/local security test runs to fail.
recommendation: Update tests/security/workflows.test.ts:L60 to expect(cost).toBeCloseTo(0.45, 2), add modulePathIgnorePatterns: ['<rootDir>/.next/'] to jest.config.cjs, and add tests covering assignments update, notebooks, tutor_sessions, and practice_events rules.

title: Self-update rule on /users/{id} allows changing email to an unverified address used by Cloud Functions for Resend email delivery
impact: A user can update their own users/{uid}.email field to any victim's email address because email is not excluded in the affectedKeys() deny-list, and onAssignmentCreated (functions/src/index.ts:L99) sends Resend assignment notifications directly to student.email.
recommendation: Require (!request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasAny(['email']) || request.resource.data.email == request.auth.token.email) in the /users/{id} update rule.

title: storage.rules blocks teacher video uploads (video/mp4, video/webm) and stores course resources under /submissions/{userId}/
impact: src/app/teacher/uploads/page.tsx:L95-L103 allows teachers to select video/mp4 and video/webm files and uploads them to submissions/{uid}/resources/..., which storage.rules rejects with storage/unauthorized because contentType only matches image/.*, application/pdf, or text/.*.
recommendation: Add a dedicated /resources/{courseId}/{allPaths=**} match block in storage.rules allowing teacher owners to upload video/(mp4|webm) up to a bounded size alongside PDFs, images, and text.

title: 11 missing composite Firestore indexes, 1-3 get() reads per security rule check, and dual-collection users/teachers/students drift
impact: Three composite queries combining 'in' and '==' filters on users and submissions lack indexes in firestore.indexes.json and will fail in production; firestore.rules:L5-L15 executes 1-3 get() reads per rule evaluation instead of custom claims; and users/{uid} vs teachers/{uid}/students/{uid} dual writes risk role/courseId drift.
recommendation: Add the missing composite indexes to firestore.indexes.json, migrate role and organizationId to Firebase Auth custom claims, and deprecate legacy teachers/ and students/ reads in favor of users/.
